title: Unify push-constant block sizes across mesh and SPH pipelines (fix VUID 10069)
purpose: Resolve push-constant range mismatch by ensuring pipeline layouts cover the full struct size used by the fragment shader and mesh shader.

steps.detail: Confirm MeshPushConstants size in C++ matches GLSL block when USE_SHELL_TLAS toggles are applied. Include new debug fields from CR 1018 only when needed.
Increase VkPushConstantRange.size in MeshParticleRenderer::createPipelineLayout to cover maximum struct used by both mesh and fragment stages (e.g., 128 bytes or exact sizeof).
For SPH pipeline, set push constant range to sizeof(SPHMeshPushConstants). If SPH frag shares a block, adjust accordingly or gate features.

acceptance: Both mesh and SPH pipelines start without push-constant validation errors
mcp_queries: search_vulkan_spec('push constant range must cover shader block 10069')
